template.name: EMA 5 Alert Candle Short
template.entry_long: low < ema(close,{p0}) and sma(high - ema(close,{p1}),{p2}) <= {p0} and close > donchian_high_prev(high,1)
template.notes: The documented short is mirrored for a long-only engine: a three-bar EMA(5) touch streak (average of high minus EmaPeriod 5 at or below zero) plus an alert candle below the EMA, then a close above the prior candle high; losing the EMA exits. The stop at the alert-candle high and the equal-distance take-profit are price-relative, and RiskPerTrade 2m is a sizing input, so no percentages are set.
